selection_process: Applications received will be scrutinized and eligible candidates will be called to appear for Personal Interview before selection panel constituted by the Bank.
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IDBI Bank Part Time Doctor Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: idbi.bank.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IDBI Bank Part Time Doctor position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Part Time Doctor position at IDBI Bank is September 12, 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS/MD degree from a recognized University/College approved by the Medical Council of India in the Allopathic system of medicine. An MD in Medicine is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Part Time Doctor position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Part Time Doctor position is that candidates should not be more than 67 years old as of September 01, 2026.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Part Time Doctor role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the scrutiny of applications received. Eligible candidates will then be invited to appear for a Personal Interview conducted by a selection panel constituted by the Bank.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Part Time Doctor recruitment at IDBI Bank is offline. Candidates need to send their bio-data in the attached format via ordinary post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Part Time Doctor position?
faq.answer: The Part Time Doctor will be compensated at a rate of Rs. 1000/- per hour for their services.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any specific experience required for the Part Time Doctor role?
faq.answer: Yes, MBBS holders need a minimum of 5 years' experience as a General Practitioner, while those with a Post Graduate Degree require a minimum of 3 years' experience as a General Practitioner, reckoned as of September 01, 2026. Internship experience is not counted.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent to Shri Tongzalal Touthang, Assistant General Manager, IDBI Bank Ltd., IDBI Building, G.S.Road, Guwahati, Pincode: 781005, Assam.

faq.question: Q9. What details should be superscribed on the envelope?
faq.answer: The envelope containing the application should be superscribed with "Application for engagement of Doctor on hourly basis".

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.
